name: s81svc_irg
why_floorplan: S81-SVCRS-3 11-10 svc_rs provider IRG (ot_s81_svc_idx_hslice_fp), rebuilt from the s81svc_irg_hsfp pilot with recipe-4 pin registers ON (COORD ruling 11-10: structural IO fix). The pilot was source-registered (pin_regs off): face_guard FAIL shared 832 (qo_codes output flops also feed their own next-state logic) + unregistered 1 (ql_v drives an AND2 before any flop), and FF hold -38.65 on 1156 IO endpoints in the sign-off frame. Every input and output now has its own pin register: +1 cycle in, +1 cycle out (svc compiler schedule moves by 2 on every IRG edge, pin-cycle lever). DIE-S81-85 svc provider form A, svc_lo fallback (b) IRG box (COORD 11-09 native-census decision): 77.76 x 276.48 exact (the band height), fill 0.399; the 8 slices of a chunk abut W->E at 86.4 pitch (8.64 seams), so the chain faces are W (ql / k_key / cs_in) and E (qo / ko_key / cs_out); clk / rst_n / hid / first straps from the chunk relay on N.  Census: drivers > 64 loads fixed structurally (q_we / pos_r kept copies, adder swap select SWREP 4, adder data cuts DRST 0 so the reset relay drives only valid bits); 33-64 load drivers stay (COORD loopgap-153x-1109 census exception, sign-off STA / slew decides).
